relationships.subject: NG2-glia
relationships.evidence_quote: they rapidly proliferate, migrate to the lesion, and secrete chondroitin sulfate proteoglycans (CSPGs), forming a chemical and physical barrier that inhibits axonal regeneration

relationships.subject: Chondroitinase ABC
relationships.evidence_quote: chondroitinase ABC to neutralize CSPG inhibition

relationships.subject: TIMP-1
relationships.evidence_quote: soluble factors secreted by macrophages/microglia (e.g., tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinase‐1 (TIMP‐1)) significantly suppress the proliferation and sphere formation of NG2‐glia in vitro

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: infiltrating macrophages and activated microglia secrete inflammatory factors such as TNF‐α and IL‐1, which can trigger hypertrophy reactions in NG2‐glia and upregulate the expression of NG2 proteoglycans

key_findings: Review proposing time-dependent dual role of NG2-glia: early CSPG secretion inhibiting regeneration, later remyelination and repair.
Chondroitinase ABC, CB1 agonists and SOX2/NeuroD1 reprogramming are preclinical strategies.
